title: Ginger soy cod with broccoli
summary: Ginger soy cod with broccoli is a chinese dinner built around cod fillets and broccoli, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat cod fillets dry and season it. Prep broccoli and fresh root ginger for Ginger soy cod with broccoli so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook cod fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook broccoli and fresh root ginger in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Ginger soy cod with broccoli before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice cod fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
